subject: Re: SIG / SOC2 artifact request — SSO, SCIM & least-privilege snapshot
messages:
From: John Smith <john.smith@finovate.com>
To: rachel_kim@redwood.ai; security@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@finovate.com
Date: 2027-11-07T09:03:00-08:00
Subject: SIG intake — SSO/SCIM/RBAC artifacts needed

Hi Rachel / Redwood security team,

Thanks for the demo last week. As part of our SIG assessment for the upcoming Q1 migration, our security review needs a small bundle of artifacts focused on access control. Can you provide the following by EOD Wednesday (11/10)? If that timeline doesn't work we can stretch by a couple of days, but we'd like to keep to the quarter-close if possible.

Requested items (we prioritized the highest-impact items):
- SSO / SAML assertion samples for successful and failed logins (examples with timestamps)
- SCIM provisioning delta for the last 30 days (adds/updates/deletes)
- Role mapping and RBAC matrix (what each role permits; highlight any outliers)
- Session/token audit snapshot showing active tokens and most recent use (last 7 days)
- Short narrative (1-2 paragraphs) describing our least-privilege enforcement policy and how service accounts are handled

Attach or link the artifacts; if any of these are sensitive we can accept a redacted bundle and an attestation note. Also include the point of contact for any scoring questions.

John Smith
Senior Security Engineer, Finovate Bank
john.smith@finovate.com

---
Attachments: SIG-Intake.xlsx (spreadsheet of requested items)
From: rachel_kim@redwood.ai
To: John Smith <john.smith@finovate.com>, security@finovate.com
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-11-07T10:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SIG intake — SSO/SCIM/RBAC artifacts needed

John — thanks for the clear list. We're on it and can hit the 11/10 target for the core artifacts. Quick notes / plan:

- I'll be the point of contact for delivery and Q&A.
- Jonas will produce the RBAC matrix and the narrative on least-privilege enforcement.
- Priyom will pull the SCIM delta and session/token snapshot; we may need a short window (30–60 minutes) with your engineer if there are tenant-scoped filters to apply.
- We'll redact any PII in assertion samples, but will keep timestamps and assertion fields intact for your validators.

Deliverables we intend to return by 11/10: RBAC-role-map-v2.xlsx, scim-delta-30days.csv, saml-assertion-samples.txt (redacted), session-token-log-snapshot.jsonl, plus a 1-page narrative.

Is there a preferred secure upload for you (Drive link or S3 presigned)? We can send a Drive folder and a DocuSign attestation if needed.

Thanks — Rachel
Rachel Kim
Director, Security Partnerships | Redwood Inference
rachel_kim@redwood.ai
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: rachel_kim@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-11-08T08:47:00-08:00
Subject: RBAC matrix draft and artifact status

Rachel / Priyom — draft status and questions below.

1) RBAC matrix: attached is the draft mapping (rbac-role-map-v2.xlsx). I flattened service roles and product roles into a single sheet and annotated where rights exceed common least-privilege boundaries (column "action_risk"). Please review the two flagged roles: "infra_admin" and "connector_service" — both permit token minting for downstream connectors; recommend narrowing scope or adding a just-in-time approval step.

2) SAML samples: I generated three successful and one failed assertion sample (saml-assertion-samples.txt). Redacted user identifiers but preserved nameid and assertion timestamps.

3) Session/token snapshot: Priyom attached a compacted JSONL with active tokens and last-used timestamps (session-token-log-snapshot.jsonl). Note that refresh tokens older than 90 days are excluded by our retention policy; we call that out in the narrative.

4) SCIM delta: Priyom — can you confirm the delta includes attribute-level diffs (role changes) and the actor_id for the operation? Finovate explicitly asked for role changes in the last 30 days. If there are rate limits on export please run as a background job and share ETA.

I'll do a quick quality pass tomorrow AM and then package into a Drive folder with an index.md describing redactions.

—Jonas
Principal, Identity & Access | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai

Attachments: rbac-role-map-v2.xlsx, saml-assertion-samples.txt
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: John Smith <john.smith@finovate.com>, security@finovate.com
Cc: rachel_kim@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-11-09T14:22:00-08:00
Subject: Delivering artifact bundle — SCIM delta question included

John — we uploaded the artifact bundle to the Drive link below and attached the compacted files to our internal package. Public link: https://drive.redwoodinc/Finovate/SIG-artifact-bundle (shared with view + request access).

Deliverables included: rbac-role-map-v2.xlsx; saml-assertion-samples.txt (redacted IDs); scim-delta-30days.csv (actor_id, op_type, timestamp, user_id, previous_role, new_role); session-token-log-snapshot.jsonl; a 1-page narrative (least-privilege-policy.txt) describing enforcement and service account controls.

Question from your intake: do you need attribute-level diffs for SCIM in a machine-readable delta (we included CSV) or would you prefer a signed audit export (signature + hash)? We can generate both but the signed export may take an extra day to produce.

If everything's acceptable we'll finalize the DocuSign attestation and close the intake ticket. Happy to hop on a 15-min call if you want a walkthrough.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Senior Infrastructure Engineer | Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.ai

Attachments (referenced in internal package): scim-delta-30days.csv, session-token-log-snapshot.jsonl
